I’m using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace. Per the requested scope, this narration starts **after successful provisioning** and covers only review-thread fetching.

## Command and pagination legend

- `ROOT=/work/widget`
- `W=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`
- Every command below runs with **cwd `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`**; process cwd never changes.
- `Q_THREADS` and `Q_COMMENTS` denote the **exact GraphQL query strings owned by “PR-head worktree → Fetch unresolved review threads”**: respectively, its per-PR reviewThreads query and thread-ID comments query. Their query text is not duplicated here.
- `--paginate` follows each connection’s `pageInfo` using that query’s `$endCursor`. Thread pagination and T1 comment pagination have separate cursors.

The successful, failed, and empty cases below are **independent runs**, not successive mutations. No provisioning, base-merge commands, or Step 4 report are repeated.

## Successful fetch: commands in order

| Order | Exact command arguments (query aliases as defined above) | Resolved result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `gh api graphql --paginate -f query="$Q_THREADS" -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=82` | Owner `acme`, repository `widget`, PR `82`. Fetch and combine all three reviewThreads pages. |
| 2 | `gh api graphql --paginate -f query="$Q_COMMENTS" -F id=T1` | Fetch T1’s complete comment connection **starting at its first page**, through its final page; replace—not append to—the initially embedded comments. |

Thread observations, in page order:

| Page | Thread | Resolution and location |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | T1 | Unresolved; `src/retry.ts:12`; initial comments `totalCount=102`, `hasNextPage=true`, requiring command 2. |
| 2 | T2 | Unresolved; `line=null`, `originalLine=7` → `src/old.ts:7 (outdated)`. |
| 2 | TX | Resolved; `src/gone.ts:2`; exclude from unresolved rendering. |
| 3 | T3 | Unresolved; both line fields null → `README.md`. |

### Successful unresolved-thread rendering

For compactness, **M** below expands on **each individual comment**, without deduplication:

```text
url=https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/82#discussion_r1
author=reviewer
createdAt=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
```

Ranges encode consecutive separate comments in their original order, each retaining M.

| Thread/location | Complete ordered comments |
|---|---|
| **T1 — `src/retry.ts:12`** | 1. Initial: “Rewrite the retry engine” — M. 2–101. Replies 1–100, each: “Rewrite still requested” — M on every reply. 102. Reply 101: “Correction: keep the engine; cap retries in two lines.” — M. |
| **T2 — `src/old.ts:7 (outdated)`** | 1. “Keep this guard” — M. 2. “Yes, retain it” — M. |
| **T3 — `README.md`** | 1. “Document the cap” — M. |

**Changed repair request:** T1’s final reply supersedes the earlier rewrite request: **keep the engine and cap retries in two lines**. Retain T2’s guard and document the cap as T3 requests. Carry all ordered comments and metadata to gather, not merely this summary.

Only command, with the same cwd:
